description: Replace Chevrotain with tree-sitter (web-tree-sitter WASM) as Langium's parser, adding incremental parsing, a DocumentIndex runtime, 7 LSP adapters, and a grammar compiler that generates grammar.js + metadata.ts + grammar.wasm from .langium files.

userStories.title: Add web-tree-sitter dependency and WASM Loader service
userStories.description: As a service implementor, I want a WasmLoader service that accepts a grammar.wasm path at init, calls Language.load(), and exposes the initialized Language — working in both Node.js and web extension environments — so that downstream services can parse documents without knowing how the WASM is loaded.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `web-tree-sitter` to packages/langium/package.json dependencies
Create packages/langium/src/parser/wasm-loader.ts with a WasmLoader service interface and DefaultWasmLoader implementation
WasmLoader accepts grammarWasmPath: string in its constructor/init and calls Parser.init() then Language.load(path)

WasmLoader is wired into the DI container in default-module.ts

FieldMetadata includes: name: string, operator: '=' | '+=' | '?=', isRef?: boolean
